units.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp reads and writes MSG and EML email formats. It converts email messages between MSG and EML representations. It constructs new email messages and saves them in MSG or EML format.

It reads, builds, and writes generic Compound File Binary containers directly through cfb_reader, cfb_storage/cfb_stream, and cfb_writer, working with file paths, in-memory streams, or raw byte buffers.
It parses and reconstructs the raw MSG directory/stream structure with msg_reader, msg_document, and msg_writer, including an optional strict-validation mode surfaced through validation_issues().

It creates, edits, saves, and reloads Outlook-style messages through mapi_message, setting the subject, plain-text and HTML bodies, and sender identity, or reaching arbitrary MAPI properties via set_property()/get_property_value() with common_message_property_id and property_type_code.

It adds To/Cc/Bcc recipients with add_recipient(), attaches regular files from byte buffers or streams with add_attachment(), and nests a full mapi_message as an embedded-message attachment with add_embedded_message_attachment().
It saves an in-memory mapi_message to .eml and loads .eml back into a mapi_message, both through the library's own MIME engine, with no external MIME dependency.

Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp exposes the mapi_message class as the primary high-level entry point for creating, editing, and reloading Outlook MSG messages, while lower-level classes such as msg_reader, msg_document, msg_writer, cfb_reader, cfb_document, and cfb_writer provide direct access to the underlying MSG and CFB container structures.

The aspose namespace serves as the top-level namespace for the Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp library, under which the aspose.email and Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp sub-namespaces organize the email processing and open-source functionality respectively.

The aspose.email namespace contains core email-related types including the high-level mapi_message class and supporting structures for message authoring, as well as low-level MSG and CFB access classes such as msg_reader, msg_document, msg_writer, cfb_reader, cfb_document, and cfb_writer.

The aspose.email.foss namespace provides the complete set of open-source MSG and CFB processing classes including mapi_message, mapi_attachment, mapi_recipient, mapi_property, mapi_property_collection, msg_reader, msg_document, msg_writer, msg_storage, msg_stream, cfb_reader, cfb_document, cfb_writer, cfb_storage, cfb_stream, and supporting enumerations and structs.
It adds mail-protocol connectivity, PST archive support, and broader MAPI property and format coverage across the full commercial product line.
cfb_document class provides methods to load a Compound File Binary document from a buffer, bytes, file, reader, or stream, and exposes its major_version, minor_version, and root.
cfb_exception class represents an exception type for errors in the CFB processing module.
cfb_node class represents a node in a CFB structure and provides access to its name, clsid, creation_time, modified_time, and indicates whether it is a storage or stream.
cfb_reader class reads a Compound File Binary document and provides access to its header, directory_entries, fat, difat, mini_fat, and methods to find and retrieve stream data.
cfb_storage class represents a storage node in a CFB document and provides methods to add child storages and streams, and to access its children.
cfb_stream class represents a stream node in a CFB document and provides methods to get and set its data.
cfb_writer class writes a Compound File Binary document and provides methods to write to bytes, file, or stream.
directory_color_flag enum lists the black and red color flags used in directory entries.

directory_entry class represents an entry in the CFB directory and provides fields for child_id, clsid, color_flag, creation_time, directory_entry_name_length, and methods to indicate if it is a root, storage, or stream.
directory_object_type enum lists the root_storage_object, storage_object, stream_object, and unknown_or_unallocated object types used in directory entries.

header class represents the header of a Compound File Binary document and provides fields for byte_order, difat, first_difat_sector_location, first_directory_sector_location, first_mini_fat_sector_location, header_clsid, header_signature, and major_version.
sector_marker enum lists the difsect, endofchain, fatsect, and freesect markers used in the sector allocation tables.

common_message_property_id enum lists property identifiers such as attach_content_id, attach_data_binary, attach_filename, attach_long_filename, attach_method, attach_mime_tag, body, body_html, display_bcc, display_cc, display_name, and display_to.

mapi_attachment class represents a MAPI attachment and provides fields for content_id, data, embedded_message, filename, and methods to load from bytes or stream, determine if it is an embedded message, and load its data.
mapi_message class represents a MAPI message and provides methods to add attachments and recipients, and access its body and attachments.
mapi_property class represents a MAPI property and provides methods to access and set its flags, property_id, property_tag, property_type, and value.
mapi_property_collection class represents a collection of MAPI properties and provides methods to add, get, set, remove, and access items.
mapi_recipient class represents a MAPI recipient and provides fields for address_type, display_name, email_address, properties, and recipient_type.

msg_document class represents a MSG document and provides methods to load from file, reader, or stream, and exposes its major_version, minor_version, root, strict flag, and conversion to cfb_document.
msg_exception class represents an exception type for errors in the MSG processing module.
msg_reader class reads a MSG document from file or stream and provides access to its cfb document, strict flag, and validation_issues.

msg_storage class represents a storage node in a MSG document and provides fields for clsid, creation_time, modified_time, name, and methods to add storages and streams, and find child storages or streams.
msg_storage_role enum lists the attachment, custom_attachment, embedded_message, generic, message, named_property_mapping, and recipient roles for MSG storages.
msg_stream class represents a stream node in a MSG document and provides fields for clsid, creation_time, data, modified_time, name, and state_bits.
msg_writer class writes a MSG document and provides methods to write to bytes, file, or stream.

property_type_code enum lists property type codes such as ptyp_binary, ptyp_boolean, ptyp_currency, ptyp_error_code, ptyp_floating32, ptyp_floating64, ptyp_floating_time, ptyp_guid, ptyp_integer16, ptyp_integer32, ptyp_integer64, and ptyp_multiple_binary.
